skill.name: shipping-and-launch
skill.description: Prepares production launches. Use when preparing to deploy to production, or when asking what needs to be in place before shipping. Use when you need a pre-launch checklist, when setting up monitoring, when planning a staged rollout, or when you need a rollback strategy.
skill.summary: Plan observable, reversible production launches with staged rollouts, release gates, and rollback procedures.
skill.author: addyosmani

content.value_statement: Production releases can fail without clear gates, monitoring, and rollback criteria. This skill creates a structured launch plan for controlled, observable deployment.
actual_capabilities: Builds pre-launch checklists covering quality, security, performance, accessibility, infrastructure, and documentation.
Defines staged rollout sequences from staging through canary and full production release.
Establishes measurable advance, hold, and rollback thresholds for release decisions.
Creates rollback plans with triggers, operational steps, database considerations, and recovery timing.
Identifies post-launch health, latency, error, logging, and business metrics to monitor.
limitations: Does not deploy software, change feature flags, or execute rollback commands.
Uses example thresholds that teams must adapt to their service objectives and risk profile.
Does not replace security, compliance, accessibility, or incident-response reviews.
Requires project-specific architecture, metrics, ownership, and deployment details from the user.

use_cases.title: Prepare a feature launch
use_cases.description: Create a release checklist, rollout stages, success metrics, and rollback triggers for a new production feature.

use_cases.title: Review release readiness
use_cases.description: Assess whether quality, infrastructure, monitoring, documentation, and operational controls are ready before approval.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a controlled rollout
use_cases.description: Define canary percentages, observation windows, ownership, communications, and decision thresholds across participating teams.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic launch checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a pre-launch checklist for [feature]. The stack is [stack], and deployment uses [platform]. Highlight missing information.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when preparing a first production release.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a staged rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a staged rollout for [change]. Include feature-flag states, audience percentages, observation windows, owners, and advance or rollback criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a release needs controlled exposure.

prompt_templates.title: Design a rollback strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a rollback plan for [release]. Consider application code, database changes, user data, dependencies, communications, verification, and recovery time.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a release changes several production components.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate launch readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this launch plan against quality, security, performance, accessibility, observability, error-budget, and rollback requirements: [plan]. Return blockers and required actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced release-governance review.

output_examples.input: Plan the launch of a task-sharing feature behind a feature flag.
output: Deploy with the flag disabled and verify health checks.
Enable for employees, then progress through 5%, 25%, 50%, and 100% cohorts.
Hold when errors or latency exceed warning thresholds; roll back when critical thresholds are crossed.

output_examples.input: Create rollback criteria for a database-backed release.
output_examples.output: Rollback triggers include data-integrity failures, doubled error rates, major latency regression, or security issues. Verify application and migration recovery separately.

output_examples.input: Review readiness for a public beta.
output: Blockers: rollback ownership is missing, alert thresholds are undefined, and the critical user flow lacks a production smoke test.
Required actions: assign owners, define measurable thresholds, document communications, and schedule post-launch monitoring.

best_practices: Define measurable release gates and owners before deployment begins.
Use feature flags and small cohorts to separate deployment from user exposure.
Verify monitoring and rollback procedures before increasing rollout percentage.
anti_patterns: Do not approve a launch using only staging results or subjective confidence.
Do not perform a large rollout without observation windows and rollback triggers.
Do not continue feature releases while the service error budget is exhausted.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy to production?
faq.answer: No. It creates plans, checklists, thresholds, and verification steps but does not execute deployment commands.

faq.question: Can it define rollout percentages?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose staged cohorts and observation windows based on your service context.

faq.question: Are the example thresholds universal?
faq.answer: No. Adapt them to your service-level objectives, baseline performance, user impact, and organizational risk tolerance.

faq.question: Does it cover database migrations?
faq.answer: It includes migration readiness and rollback considerations, but your team must validate engine-specific recovery procedures.

faq.question: What information produces the best plan?
faq.answer: Provide the architecture, deployment platform, feature-flag system, baselines, service objectives, dependencies, owners, and rollback constraints.

faq.question: Can it replace a security review?
faq.answer: No. It includes security readiness checks but does not replace specialist testing, compliance review, or threat modeling.
